Plot a landform classification

plot.landform.Rd

Plots the map of the classes, a bar plot of the area of each class, or the standardised TPI surface(s), from an object returned by landform.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'landform'
plot(
  x,
  what = c("classes", "area", "tpi"),
  hillshade = FALSE,
  alpha = 0.6,
  leg.pos = NULL,
  leg.cex = 0.8,
  main = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An object of class "landform".

what

What to plot: "classes" (default), "area", or "tpi".

hillshade

Logical. For what = "classes", draw the classes semi-transparently over a hillshade of the elevation raster. Default FALSE.

alpha

Opacity of the classes relative to the hillshade drawn over them (0 to 1; the hillshade is drawn with opacity 1 - alpha). Default 0.6.

leg.pos

Legend position for the map (a legend keyword); NULL (default) places it outside the map, to its right.

leg.cex

Magnification of the legend text. Default 0.8.

main

Plot title; a sensible default is used if NULL.

...

Further arguments passed to plot (for maps) or barplot (for what = "area").

Value

x, invisibly.

Examples

dem <- malta_dtm()
sp <- landform(dem, scale = 9, plot = FALSE)
plot(sp)
plot(sp, hillshade = TRUE)

plot(sp, what = "area")

plot(sp, what = "tpi")
